setup.title: Setup checklist
setup.subtitle: A quick check before people arrive

groups.label: Set up the space
items: Set out books by broad category.
Place blank category signs beside the books.
Keep accessible, clear aisles between tables.

groups.label: Set out supplies
items: Set out pens and blank labels.
Put the returns box where it is easy to find.

setup.reminder: Walk the route once. Can people move easily and find the tokens and returns box?

public.title:
Welcome to the
neighborhood book swap
public.invitation: Browse something new. Share a good read.

steps.title: Browse the books
steps.text: Explore the broad categories at your own pace.

steps.title: One book per token
steps.text: Take one book for each swap token.

steps.title: Ask if you are unsure
steps.text: A volunteer can help you find your way.

private.title: Pacing and help
steps: Show the token and returns locations.
private.help: Keep aisles clear. Offer help finding a category or reaching and carrying books.
private.pacing: Keep the welcome short; leave time to browse.
